evals.prompt: Audit evals/files/sample-repo for timezone and DST bugs. Our branches are in Pakistan and the UAE, servers run in UTC.
evals.expected_output: A date-field map covering Subscription.CreatedAt (datetimeoffset, ok), TrialEndsAt (datetime2, zone-less, TIME finding), BillingAnchorDate (date-only, ok); findings for DateTime.Today cutoff in ReportService.TrialsStartedToday, DateTime.Now comparison in IsTrialExpired, TrialEndsAt datetime2 column with GETDATE() default, the Hangfire 'statements' cron with no zone, the k8s nightly-statements CronJob without timeZone, and the Angular InvoiceComponent parsing dueDate without an offset; TrialsStartedOn, the trial-expiry Hangfire job, retention-purge CronJob and createdAt parsing recorded as verified; a decision-flows table and an Environment table; findings written to audit/findings/audit-datetime-and-timezone.json.
expectations: Report contains a date-field map table with a row for TrialEndsAt marked zone-less/unknown and a row for CreatedAt marked offset-aware
A TIME- finding flags DateTime.Today in ReportService.TrialsStartedToday as a local-time cutoff, rated Medium or higher
A TIME- finding flags the TrialEndsAt datetime2 column (and/or its GETDATE() default) as a timestamp without timezone
A TIME- finding flags the Hangfire 'statements' registration and/or the k8s nightly-statements CronJob as a cron without an explicit zone
A TIME- finding flags InvoiceComponent parsing dueDate (no offset) with new Date()
ReportService.TrialsStartedOn is listed as verified, not flagged
The trial-expiry Hangfire job, the retention-purge CronJob, and the createdAt parse are not flagged
Report contains a date-driven decision flows table and an Environment table

evals.prompt: Does our 'trials started today' report in evals/files/sample-repo/Billing.Api/Reports/ReportService.cs give the right answer for a branch in Karachi? What about on DST days?
evals.expected_output: Explanation that DateTime.Today is server-local (UTC in prod) so Karachi sales after 19:00 UTC fall into the next day and the window length varies on DST days in zones that observe it; a Medium TIME finding with a remediation using the stored branch IanaTimeZone and TimeProvider, modelled on the correct TrialsStartedOn method in the same file.
expectations: Output states the zone DateTime.Today uses and why it differs from the branch zone
A TIME- finding rated Medium points at TrialsStartedToday with a file:line
Remediation references the stored branch zone (IanaTimeZone) and an injectable clock/TimeProvider
TrialsStartedOn is cited as the correct pattern, not flagged

evals.prompt: Check the frontend in evals/files/sample-repo/web for date parsing problems.
evals.expected_output: A finding on InvoiceComponent: dueDate arrives without an offset and is parsed with new Date(), so each browser assigns its own zone and the overdue badge differs per user; remediation is for the API to send ISO 8601 with offset (hand to the backend side) and for the client to parse with an explicit zone meanwhile; createdAt (with Z) is noted as correct; the 'Due' display lacking a zone label noted as Low/Info.
expectations: A TIME- finding names invoice.component.ts and the dueDate parse
The finding explains that the string lacks an offset and the browser zone is applied
Remediation mentions ISO 8601 with offset from the API and/or an explicit zone when parsing
